maker: OH Channel Innovations Co., Ltd. (formerly Hitachi Channel Solutions)
name: SumiROBO automatic layout marking robot
summary: Automatic layout marking robot system that drives to marking positions from CAD data in contact with a surveying instrument and draws lines and text on the floor. Sold in Japan since November 2021 by Hitachi Channel Solutions, which became OH Channel Innovations in October 2026.

germany.statusNote: Sold in Japan only; no German or EU seller found. Hitachi Channel Solutions merged into OH Channel Innovations on 1 October 2026 and its product pages moved; no SumiROBO page was found on the new site.

specs.label: Closest marking distance to columns and walls
specs.conditions: after the 2023 upgrade; before about 800 mm
specs.quote: 機能拡張によって３５０ミリメートル離れた場所にも墨出しができるようになり

specs.label: Drawing data
specs.value: cloud service extracts marking data from CAD drawings, with a check function
specs.quote: ＣＡＤデータから墨出し作業情報を抽出して、データを変換するためのクラウドサービスを用意した

specs.label: What it draws
specs.value: straight lines, text and image symbols such as equipment categories
specs.quote: 直線や文字情報を自動で描く

specs.label: Registration
specs.value: listed in the MLIT new technology information system NETIS
specs.quote: 国土交通省の新技術情報提供システム（ＮＥＴＩＳ）に、建設現場の生産性向上が期待できる技術として新たに登録された

notes: Works with a surveying instrument that guides the robot to each marking position.
Self-driving on floors; wheels assumed, not stated. Size, weight and battery life not found on a readable page.
